author: Cinna Davis (with OpenAI Codex)
statement: For all source labels indexed at the same grade, integer charges and output energies, the charged cubic weighted moment has scalar compression on each fixed partition-length parity sector, with the same scalar in both; both sectors have p(E)/poly(E) capacity, and the scalar pairing is affine in E. An author-checked all-grade argument is supplied. Full-label ranks 2,4,5,8 at h=3,4,5,6 are finite observations only; no uniform pairing rank or SAT improvement is proved. At h=7,8,9,10 the energy-interpolated pairing ranks are 10,15,19,27; a finite control rejects simple t1-stability of the kernel.
remaining_obligations: Independent review of the charged low-weight zero-mode argument and capacity bound
Uniform high-rank scalar label pairing and bounded normalizer
Fixed-fraction shift filtering or better actual cut-rank estimates and full SAT cost accounting
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no independent or formal review
